fields.Name: T229 - Credentials Derived Status Filter
fields.Description: Status is computed client-side from IsActive + ExpiresAt (getStatusClass), then filtered over a bespoke card/table renderer — not a database column filter on the generic grid.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and choose 'Credentials', then open the 'Credentials' left-nav section. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away. Open the Filters popover in the toolbar and set Status to 'Active' (then try 'Expiring Soon' or 'Expired'). Verify the credential cards/rows respond: the visible set narrows to matches OR a clear 'No credentials match your current filters' empty state appears. Also confirm each credential shows a derived colored status pill (Active / Inactive / Expiring Soon / Expired).

judgeValidationCriteria: The Filters popover opens and exposes a Status dropdown
Selecting a status narrows the visible credentials OR shows a no-match empty state
Credential cards/rows display a derived status pill (Active/Inactive/Expiring Soon/Expired)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
